name: Terrarium 60x45x50
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x45x50 cm. Volume: 135.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 60x45x50 cm terrarium has the same floor as the 60x45x30 model, but 20 cm more height. That gives 135 liters of volume. The extra height is used for deeper substrate, taller branches or a greater distance between the lamp and the animal. The format is horizontal, without a 3D background, with film on the outer sides.

Kingsnakes climb readily, so they will use branches placed up to half the height. A young ball python also accepts a low, thick branch. Tortoises and a skink do not need the height, but they get a substrate layer of around ten centimeters for digging in. The 2700 cm² floor suits young animals, while it is too short for an adult bearded dragon.

If you do not need the height, the lower 60x45x30 model takes up less room. We have longer terrariums of similar width as the 80x50x50 and 90x45x45 +3D. Film goes on the outside, and you choose the pattern from the 34 on offer. If you need a height between 30 and 50 cm, we build it in 7 to 14 days.
